field_text_formatted.value: What comes back is Drupal's vocabulary, not CKEditor's. drupalInsertImage is Drupal's name for uploadImage, and an item your build has not loaded is dropped with a console warning rather than an error, so the editor comes up fine, quietly missing buttons the format says it has.
